dedupe_keys.name: smart radar and ktlx wsr 88d data and wind retrievals during the landfall of hurricane florence 2018

description: This Zenodo collection publishes radar observations and three-dimensional wind retrievals during Hurricane Florence landfall in North Carolina on 13–14 September 2018. The University of Oklahoma research team combines SMART radar observations with the Wilmington KLTX weather radar to derive winds over roughly 26 hours at six-to-ten-minute intervals. Version 2 provides CF/Radial and standard NetCDF files, including retrieval coverage flags; the earlier version retains raw Sigmet material. Access is free under CC-BY-4.0. The data can test storm-wind fields used in regional infrastructure-exposure models and complement data-era5-reanalysis at finer event scale. The lowest analysed level is approximately 500 m, so these fields cannot be used directly as surface gusts or building loads. Coverage varies with radar geometry, and the deposit title incorrectly names KTLX while its description identifies KLTX.
